prize_parts.citation: For the development of general palladium-catalysed carbon-nitrogen cross-coupling

statement.case_for: I keep B002 as my preferred configuration. Buchwald and Hartwig, working independently, turned amine arylation into a general catalytic reaction through mechanism-driven ligand design, and the oxidative addition, amine binding and reductive elimination steps have been worked out in detail and confirmed by many groups for more than two decades. It is used daily in discovery and process chemistry to make aryl amines, a central motif in drugs and materials. The attribution is the cleanest on the shortlist: two names, no forced exclusion, and a precursor (Kosugi's aminostannane chemistry) that was neither general nor catalytic in the modern sense. I would word the citation around general catalytic C-N coupling, which separates it from the 2010 C-C prize and makes no priority ruling on the tin chemistry. The science and the credit are both settled, and I do not need to estimate how a field will mature.
statement.case_against: The 2010 prize on palladium cross-coupling makes this look like a later chapter of a recognised field, and several colleagues weigh that heavily against it. It is a generalisation of an existing idea more than a new concept, whereas targeted protein degradation introduces a new mode of action. A two-name citation also sidesteps Kosugi's precedence instead of resolving it. I recognise that if the committee sees B023 as timely and B002 as late, a reasonable member could choose B023 and I would not call that a mistake.

responses.point: Chabes argues that the thalidomide and cereblon half of B023 already has years of approved-drug use in myeloma, so clinical validation is not hypothetical, and that my maturity bar for B023 is higher than the committee applies elsewhere.
responses.response: This moves me. I had treated the missing approved bifunctional degrader as a general weakness of B023, but the lenalidomide and pomalidomide record validates the glue half clinically, and I now regard the timing objection as a ranking factor and not a disqualifier. It does not change my first choice, because that approved-drug evidence supports the cereblon strand and not the PROTAC strand that Crews and Deshaies founded, so one citation still has to join two histories. I now rate B023 as a fully acceptable winner if the committee prefers it, and I would vote for it before any other alternative.

responses.point: Aqvist asks how I would configure B023 without a three-name cap forcing an arbitrary cut, and says a two-part PROTAC plus glue prize would be incoherent because both rest on the same induced-proximity idea.
responses.response: I accept that a two-part prize would be artificial, and I did not propose one. My answer is that I would not try to fix the cap. If B023 is chosen, I would side with Aqvist and Linke that the citation should be anchored in the designed small molecule and the ubiquitin-proteasome system, not in one lineage, and the third name should be decided on the criterion Aqvist states, mechanism discovery versus platform generalisation. Handa's cereblon identification explains an approved drug class and Ciulli's work generalised PROTACs. Neither is clearly better. That unresolved choice is why I still prefer B002, where no such choice arises.

responses.point: Somfai wants the B002 citation worded around general catalytic C-N coupling and not palladium cross-coupling broadly, so it differs from 2010 and does not rule on the tin work, and doubts perovskites as a pairing.
responses.response: I adopt that wording; it is my citation above. I agree the 2010 prize honoured C-C coupling and that C-N coupling needed a different ligand and mechanistic solution at the amine-binding and reductive-elimination steps. I accept your doubt about perovskites. Since a second part would leave a single name, I am not proposing one, and I keep B009 only as a low alternative.

responses.point: Linke accepts B002 as the strongest case on maturity and breadth but puts more weight on conceptual novelty, and asks whether the committee prefers a late, safe achievement or a fresher conceptual one.
responses.response: I do not think the choice is between safe and fresh. Aryl amines are core to medicines, and C-N coupling changed what chemists can build, which is a conceptual advance in catalyst design. I accept that B023 is the fresher idea, and Linke's own admission that the missing approved PROTAC is the best argument against it is where I started. Where we differ is that I weigh settled credit more than novelty.

responses.point: Brzezinski says the premature-timing objection to B023 does not outweigh the 2010 overlap and the open Kosugi question against B002, and asks whether the committee prefers recognition that is late and safe or timely and conceptually new.
responses.response: The Kosugi issue is real, but the citation can handle it. Kosugi's tin-amide coupling used stoichiometric, toxic tin reagents and was not a general catalytic method, so a Buchwald and Hartwig citation rests on general catalytic amination and does not deny the precursor. I agree the committee should record that reasoning if it goes with B002. On timing, I now concede, after Chabes's point, that the mechanism is settled, so my remaining preference for B002 is about attribution and not about immaturity.

uncertainties: How much weight the 2010 cross-coupling prize should carry against B002; I read it as covering C-C coupling only, but several colleagues weigh it more.
Whether a citation can credit Buchwald and Hartwig without implying a ruling on Kosugi's earlier aminostannane work.
Whether the PROTAC and cereblon glue strands of B023 can be honestly joined, and whether Handa or Ciulli is the better third name.
My assessments rest on recalled knowledge and not on independent verification of priority claims.
statement.conflict_note: No change from round 1. My profile records Peter Brzezinski as a Stockholm University colleague; I work in electron crystallography and porous materials, which is not connected to B002, B023 or B009, and none of the people in my preferred configuration is a collaborator, mentor or colleague. I report no conflict requiring recusal.
